service.description: A page of the stock ledger (AssetDetail with its asset), newest first, each row with its source (receipt, issuance, adjustment, a revaluation split or a partial move with its other asset, or another ledger entry), the document of the source (work effort, shipment, return, order or count), the variance reason, the user who received or issued it, and its correction chain: the later rows of the same receipt or issuance correct the first (a cancelled issuance, a changed receipt quantity). Unit and acquire cost only with ACCOUNTING_VIEW (costIncluded). Refuses an asset outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: facilityIds
parameter.description: The caller's facilities: rows of assets elsewhere are left out. Null for no narrowing; an empty list is no row.

parameter.name: sourceType
parameter.description: receipt, issuance, adjustment, split (revaluation splits and partial moves) or other

parameter.name: pageNoLimit
parameter.description: Every row on one page, up to 5000 (an export)

service.description: The lineage of an asset, a lot (its assets), a shipment or a work effort, upstream (where it came from), downstream (where it went) or both, as nodes (assets, documents, counts, Unknown provenance) and edges (receipts, issuances, adjustments, partial moves and revaluation splits, the pair of ledger rows linked by otherAssetId), bounded by maxDepth (1 to 10, default 5) and maxNodes (default 200, at most 1000) and cycle-safe: a node is followed once in each direction, and an edge to a node seen before is marked joined. An asset with no receipt and no split into it shows Unknown provenance with its first known movement; a receipt or issuance naming no document an Unknown end. Stock outside the user's organizations or the caller's facilities is one restricted node, not followed and not named; an edge to it carries nothing of that stock (no product, quantity, date, cost or reason), and a visible node's edges to it are one. Each neighbor query reads at most the nodes still allowed. Answers pages of nodes and edges and a tree (rows keyed by their path, a node reached again shown without its children). Cost (acquire and unit cost) only with ACCOUNTING_VIEW. Refuses a root the user may not see (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: rootType
parameter.description: asset, lot, shipment, workEffort, return or order

parameter.name: pageNoLimit
parameter.description: Every node and edge on one page, up to 5000 (an export)

actions.script: for (const name of Object.keys(found)) context[name] = found[name]
